title: 第1213章 十绝仙子名震一域第1212章 仙府令牌天仙大阵
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 孙流云吃惊：“此等天仙大阵，巅峰时期若有天仙初期坐镇，只怕天仙中期大能也难以破阵。”
“即便没有仙道领域修士坐镇主导阵法，仍旧是天仙级别大阵，天仙之下几乎难以攻破。”
“青元老弟你一人也能破阵？”
孙流云不是不信，而是惊讶。
天仙大阵四个字，便已道尽一切。
天仙级别的大阵，是天仙大能以毕生道行凝聚而成的智慧结晶，蕴含天仙对天地法则的理解与运用。
以阵证道，还是阵修，何其可怕？
这种阵法，便是一座活的要塞、一座会呼吸的城池。
天仙之下攻击天仙大阵，如蚍蜉撼树。
李青元自豪一笑，昂首挺胸：“这是自然，我可是十绝前辈唯一的阵道传人，得其阵法真传。”
第一御极开口道：“如此说来，此次天仙洞府和四阶仙脉之争，我们或许并不需要与旁人殊死搏斗。”
紫霄饮酒一杯，柔唇轻抿，唇角含笑：“不是或许，而是一定。”
“各位静观其变即可。”
她说得轻描淡写，却无比坚信。
第一御极点头：“好，我等静候佳音。”
造化仙宗高层，一个个盘坐虚空，耐心等待。
众人的目光，尽数落在那座乳白色光幕之上。
三分之一刻钟、半刻钟、一刻钟。
轰隆！
天仙大阵骤然爆发，一杆杆阵旗显化，一道道阵眼活了过来，大阵枢纽运转，方圆数百万里的天地之力被阵法道纹驱动起来，形成一座古老杀阵。
不是大阵崩溃，而是大阵易主。
天地之间，风云变色，方圆数百万里的天地之力被大阵牵引，汇聚成一道道肉眼可见的法则之链。
这些法则之链如同千万条巨蟒，在大阵之中游走穿梭，听凭十绝仙子调遣。
第一御极、金魔神、孙流云等人面露惊骇。
“天仙大阵复苏了？”
“不是复苏，确切来说，是被掌控了。”
紫霄仙子放下酒杯，眸中紫光流转，饶有兴致地望着大阵方向：“她不是在破阵，她是在夺阵。”
妙乐赞叹道：“时间刚好一刻钟。”
说一刻钟，便是一刻钟。
不多一分，不少一秒。
十绝仙子破阵之能，当真恐怖如斯。
嘭嘭嘭……
一道道人影被阵法之力扫出，正是联手闯入天仙大阵的一百几十个真仙，包括半步天仙境的董风、金电、雷轰、天云等六个半步天仙，都被震飞出来。
一百多道身影如断线风筝，倒飞而出，撞碎一座座山峰，砸出一道道绵延数万里的沟壑。
他们并非被大阵的防御力量震飞，而是被十绝仙子操控的大阵主动驱逐。
天仙大阵，已成为她手中利刃。
六大半步天仙、其余真仙巅峰、真仙后期、真仙中期……全部真仙修士口吐鲜血，元气大伤。
他们方才闯入大阵，本以为只是面对一座死阵，联手或可以蛮力破阵。
然而大阵突然复苏，天仙级别的法则之力如潮水般涌来，将他们每个人的法力都震得七零八落。
若非十绝仙子只是驱逐而非杀戮，他们早已身受杀劫。
雷轰难以置信：“这座天仙大阵沉寂已久，怎会突然复苏？”
content_en:
Sun Liuyun was surprised: "Such a great formation of immortals, if there are early-stage immortals at its peak, it would be difficult for even the powerful mid-stage immortals to break the formation."
"Even if there are no monks from the immortal realm taking charge of the formation, it is still a great formation at the level of a heavenly being, and it is almost difficult for a heavenly being to break through it."
"Brother Qingyuan, can you break the formation by yourself?"
Sun Liuyun was not disbelieving, but was surprised.
These four words of the Heavenly Immortal Formation have said everything.
The great formation at the level of a heavenly being is the crystallization of wisdom condensed by a great power of heavenly beings through a lifetime of practice, and contains the immortals’ understanding and application of the laws of heaven and earth.
How terrible is it to use arrays to prove the Tao, or to cultivate arrays?
This formation is a living fortress, a breathing city.
Attacking the great array of heavenly beings from under the heavenly beings is like a worm shaking a tree.
Li Qingyuan smiled proudly and held his head high: "This is natural. I am the only formation successor of Senior Shi Jue, and I have obtained the true inheritance of his formation."
The First Yuji said: "In this way, in this battle between the Tianxian Cave and the fourth-level immortal veins, we may not need to fight to the death with others."
Zixiao drank a glass of wine, pursed her lips softly, and said with a smile: "It's not maybe, but it's certain."
"Just wait and see what happens."
She spoke lightly, but with great conviction.
The First Yuji nodded: "Okay, I'll wait for the good news."
The senior officials of the Creation Immortal Sect were sitting cross-legged in the void, waiting patiently.
Everyone's eyes fell on the milky white light curtain.
A third of a quarter of an hour, a half of an hour, a quarter of an hour.
Boom!
The Celestial Immortal Formation suddenly erupted, formation flags appeared, formation eyes came to life, the formation hub rotated, and the power of heaven and earth millions of miles around was driven by the formation Dao patterns, forming an ancient killing formation.
It's not that the formation collapsed, but that the formation changed hands.
Between heaven and earth, the situation changes color, and the power of heaven and earth millions of miles around is pulled by the great formation, converging into chains of laws visible to the naked eye.
These chains of laws are like thousands of giant pythons, swimming back and forth in the formation, at the disposal of the Shijue Fairy.
"This?"
The First Yuji, Jin Demon God, Sun Liuyun and others looked horrified.
"The Celestial Formation has revived?"
"It's not recovery, to be precise, it's being controlled."
Fairy Zixiao put down her wine glass, with purple light flowing in her eyes, looking in the direction of the formation with interest: "She is not breaking the formation, she is seizing it."
Miao Le praised: "It's exactly a quarter of an hour."
When you say a quarter of an hour, it means a quarter of an hour.
Not a minute more, not a second less.
The ability of the Ten Ultimate Fairies to break formations is truly terrifying.
Bang bang bang...
One after another, the figures were swept out by the power of the formation. It was the one hundred or dozens of true immortals who had joined forces to break into the immortal formation, including the six half-step immortals Dong Feng, Jin Dian, Lei Hong, and Tianyun who were in the half-step immortal realm. They were all knocked out.
More than a hundred figures flew out like kites with broken strings, smashing into mountains and creating ravines that stretched for tens of thousands of miles.
They were not blown away by the defensive power of the formation, but actively expelled by the formation controlled by Fairy Shijue.
The Heavenly Immortal Formation has become a sharp blade in her hand.
"Pfft~"
The six half-step immortals, the rest of the peak true immortals, the late true immortals, the middle true immortals... all the true immortal monks vomited blood and their vitality was severely damaged.
They had just broken into the formation, and they thought they were just facing a death formation, and if they worked together, they might be able to break through the formation with brute force.
However, the formation suddenly revived, and the power of heavenly-level laws surged in like a tide, knocking the magic power of each of them to pieces.
If Shi Jue Fairy hadn't just driven them away instead of killing them, they would have been killed long ago.
Lei Hong couldn't believe it: "This immortal formation has been dormant for a long time, how could it suddenly revive?"
